sources.facts: Eighteen identified heritage stops with numeric coordinates. The seven gateways are Mahadarwaza, Ganesh, Pir, Haathi, Shivai Devi, Mena and Kulup.
Standing triangular hilltop complex, stone birthplace, seven gated enclosures, Badami and Ganga-Jamuna.
Firsthand 1912 account of dressed stone, pointed openings, two rows of Amberkhana vaults, an attached timber shrine element, the flying mosque arch, north outwork and stone rooms.
Written parliamentary publication describes the birthplace exterior as a two-storey building.
Firsthand written account of the dark stone two-storey birthplace and its projecting jharokha. Photographs from this account were not used.
Archaeological Survey’s continuing conservation of the surviving fort under its new 2025 heritage status.
